subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode selection & migration plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nova-health.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode selection & migration plan

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs (from our call):
- Sensitive patient data, requires HIPAA controls + audit logs; likely needs VPC or private tenancy.
- Current traffic: ~120 peak concurrent requests during business hours; ~15k tokens/minute on average.
- Target latency: p50 ~200ms for single-turn prompts, p95 < 500ms.
- Primary workload: structured summarization and clinical note generation using an instruction-style prompt; model quality is critical.
- Migration: currently using another LLM API (OpenAI) + an in-house GPU cluster for heavy jobs. Desire to move away from split infra to reduce ops overhead and improve SLAs.

Deployment modes we discussed: Hosted API (fastest ramp), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput), Private (VPC / on-prem for strict data residency). You mentioned procurement and security will push for Private but would like options/costs for Dedicated as a stepping stone.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I'll share a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines a 6-18 week POC approach: security review, small POC on Dedicated, then Private evaluation if required. 
2) Book a technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer (cc'd) to validate latency/throughput targets and confirm integration points.
3) You to share current architecture doc + procurement timelines and any must-have security docs (SOC2, BAA requirements).

I'll attach the MAP draft and a short checklist for the tech call. If the 20-30 minute tech slot next week works, please propose a time.

Best,

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nova-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nova Health IT <it@nova-health.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode selection & migration plan

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency / compliance: we need data to stay in our VPC for production PHI workloads. For initial testing we can allow a hosted solution if data is obfuscated/anonymized.
- Traffic: 120 concurrent is peak for our web front-end. For batch processing (overnight summarization) we run ~500k tokens/hour on our GPU cluster.
- Models: we currently call OpenAI for low-latency features and run fine-tuned LlamaX models on our cluster for heavier tasks. We are open to Redwood hosting the model if you support the LlamaX variant and can meet latency SLOs; otherwise we'd consider hybrid (hosted for low-risk features, Dedicated/Private for PHI).
- Procurement: target decision window ~Q3 2026; procurement team will need an SOW, pricing for Dedicated 3-month and 12-month commitments, and a security & compliance package (SOC2 + BAA).

I'll attach our existing architecture diagram and procurement requirements so you can see constraints.

Samir
Director of ML Platforms, Nova Health
samir.patel@nova-health.com
[Attachment: existing_architecture_diagram.pdf]
[Attachment: procurement_requirements.docx]

Samir — thanks for the details and the attachments. I looped in Neha (Solutions Engineer) so she can lead the tech deep-dive. Below is a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) and suggested timeline: 

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Week 0: Security review (BAA/SOC2 docs + redlines)
- Week 1-2: Tech deep-dive + test plan to validate p50/p95 and throughput on Dedicated pool
- Week 3-6: POC on Dedicated (small reserved capacity), run both live traffic tests and batch migration tests from your cluster
- Week 7-8: Review results + decision on Private VPC/on-prem deployment if required

Neha — can you confirm availability for a 30-minute deep-dive next Tue (May 26) or Wed (May 27) between 10-14 PT? Also please review Samir's attachments ahead of the call and flag any immediate blockers.

Samir — for the POC we'll want answers to the following so we can size Dedicated capacity and propose quantization/throughput profiles: 
- Typical prompt length and max tokens returned (avg tokens/request)
- Ratio of real-time API traffic vs. batch jobs and preferred cutover approach
- Whether you require on-prem connectors (HSM/KMS) for keys or can use customer-managed KMS in cloud VPC

I'll update the MAP with dates once we lock the tech call.

Best,

—Marissa

Hi Neha / Marissa —

Thanks — May 26 at 10:30 PT works for the tech deep-dive. I've added a couple quick answers below to help you size: 

- Avg tokens per request: 180 tokens in, ~250 tokens out (mostly summarization). Peak single-turn requests see up to ~1k tokens.
- Real-time vs batch: ~70% real-time API traffic, 30% batch (batch runs off-peak on our cluster).
- Models: LlamaX-13B fine-tuned with custom medical weights; we'd prefer Redwood to host the LlamaX variant or run Dedicated with our weights.
- KMS: for POC we can use customer-managed KMS in our cloud VPC; production PHI workloads will need VPC/private tenancy and HSM integration.
- Procurement notes: procurement team requests a 30-day trial option to validate performance before committing to a 12-month Dedicated contract.

Attachments: forwarding architecture doc and procurement checklist.

Looking forward to Tuesday.
